name: Half Past Fate: Romantic Distancing
source:
Finding true love is hard enough when it’s in person! Build a relationship through the screen as a couple copes with lockdown life by staying connected online! Will their love be loud and clear, or will their signals fade away?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492480/Half_Past_Fate_Romantic_Distancing/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
找到真爱本身就已经很难了！当一对情侣通过保持在线联系应对封锁生活时，通过屏幕建立关系！他们的爱会大声而清晰，还是他们的信号会消失？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492480/Half_Past_Fate_Romantic_Distancing/]Steam[/url]]
